criteria.statement: Short, dev, uppercase, unknown, and pre-floor revisions fail admission.
A modern image fails unless its immutable metadata contains the exact selected revision and required safety epoch.
An unlabeled legacy image fails unless its exact image ID is listed with a post-floor revision.
Rollback generation preserves unrelated services but replaces Bahia with an admitted post-fix image.
The edge workflow is manual, digest-pinned, uses only the sanitized rollback Compose file, and never rewrites the dedicated relay image.
Historical Compose backups are rewritten to the admitted rollback image while originals are retained only as mode-000 checksummed evidence.
The local Docker image store retains only admitted Bahia backend images; purge refuses active references and re-audits immediately before removal.
Live Bahia uses a post-floor image while public health, readiness, and relay rejection telemetry remain healthy.
